scope.source_identity: two previously exposed development image clusters, one seed each
scope.thresholds: same six-calibration-source fixed BF16 q25/q50 thresholds as TEAL video study
scope.mask_action: per-element mask retained; group union only defines potential skipped W2 columns
scope.aggregation: four site means within each source, then the two sources equally
scope.shuffle: same paid fixed PCG64 permutation for every site and both sizes
scope.tail: M16: 4 real rows; M32: 20 real rows; no padding counted
scope.interpretation: logical W2 MAC upper bound and tile occupancy, no sparse-kernel timing or video quality

limits: Two development sources and four selected teacher sites; no inference about every site, unseen source, sparse GPU speed or video quality.
